literal_meaning: মাথা নিচু বা নত করা (to bow or lower the head)
figurative_meaning_en: to feel humiliated, ashamed, or inferior; to accept submission or defeat
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পরাজয়ের পর সে মাথা নত করে দাঁড়িয়ে রইল।
ভুল স্বীকার করে মাথা নত করা তার স্বভাব।
example_sentences_in_english: After his defeat, he stood with his head bowed.
Bowing one's head in admission of mistake is his nature.
history: References historical figures like Bedouin and Genghis Khan in Kazi Nazrul Islam's poetry, symbolizing ultimate submission despite pride.
note: The idiom draws from gestures of respect or defeat common in South Asian cultures.
